build_split.vps_side_goal: finish contracts, deterministic control, scheduling, world-model fusion, bridge semantics, fixtures, CI and release wiring so local Claude Code/Opus integration is primarily real hardware/OS binding plus acceptance
build_split.local_final_goal: bind actual sensors/permissions/dashboard and execute hardware acceptance without inventing new architecture

workpackages.title: PerceptionSource + PerceptionCapability + immutable permission snapshot
acceptance: per-source SEE/ANALYZE/MEMORY/RAW_RETENTION/REMOTE_FRAME/EXTERNAL_VLM represented
snapshot has exact digest/generation/provenance
revoked or stale snapshot cannot authorize new work

workpackages.title: ObserveIntent and VisualNeed binding
acceptance: VisualNeed can compile to bounded ObserveIntent without performing capture
intent binds source, ROI, heads, freshness, deadline, priority, compute ceiling and permission digest
intent has no truth/effect/completion authority

workpackages.title: RetinaCaptureBroker single-owner/multiple-reader contract
acceptance: one capture owner per source
bounded in-memory references/ring
no unbounded queue growth
consumer fan-out cannot reopen/contend for underlying source

workpackages.title: Dynamic Retina/Cortex worker scheduler 0..4
acceptance: 0..4 active analysis slots selected under explicit compute policy
source count independent of worker count
stale low-value work coalesced/dropped under backpressure
perception cannot exceed cognitive envelope ceilings

workpackages.title: Temporal ObservationWindow and cross-source fusion
acceptance: source-local monotonic ordering preserved
freshness and clock-domain/skew metadata explicit
stale observations cannot silently become current world state
multi-view disagreement preserved

workpackages.title: PerceptionWorldBridge typed events / ObserveIntent return path
acceptance: typed percept events are default bridge payload
raw/ROI bridge requires REMOTE_FRAME capability
VLM path additionally requires EXTERNAL_VLM capability
bridge loss degrades without corrupting local identity or fabricating observations

workpackages.title: Dashboard capability plane and PerceptionAuditReceipt contract
acceptance: dashboard can pause all Retina and revoke each capability per source
live worker/source/reason visibility
auditable permission snapshot and observation execution receipts
raw keylogging/clipboard/password capture excluded from baseline

workpackages.title: Perception Fabric sustained multi-source acceptance
acceptance: four permissioned sources represented concurrently
0..4 workers adapt dynamically
zero generic VLM calls in normal test
zero raw-frame persistence under default policy
bounded RAM/queues
world model receives typed epistemic/time/source provenance
GRID10-triggered re-look works
permission revocation invalidates outstanding intent
cognition remains within resource/latency envelope

completion_law: Frankenstein 2.0 perception integration is incomplete if final local Claude Code/Opus work must invent permission, scheduling, epistemic, temporal-fusion, world-model or bridge semantics rather than only bind host-specific sensors/permissions and verify them.
